\section*{Multiple Choice (10 marks)}
\begin{enumerate}[label=\arabic*.]
\item \duallayerbox{Which of the following is true of the assessment of power in the arms?}{Which of the following correctly describes Grade 3/5 power in the assessment of power in the arms?}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Extension at the elbow is produced by the biceps muscle
    \item Grade 3/5 (MRC scale) represents movement of the arm only when gravity is eliminated
    \item Grade 2/5 power represents movement of the arm only against gravity.
    \item The brachioradialis muscle is responsible for shoulder abduction
    \item Grade 0/5 power represents full range of motion with resistance
\end{enumerate}
\item The influence of genetics on longevity is \duallayerbox{estimated to be about}{most commonly reported as around}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item 33\%
    \item 40\%
    \item 60\%
    \item 20\%
    \item 80\%
\end{enumerate}
\item \duallayerbox{The World Health Organization recommends zinc supplements for which groups of people?}{For which groups of people does the World Health Organization recommend zinc supplements to improve physical performance in adult men?}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Men with high physical activity levels
    \item All women over the age of 50
    \item All children in high income areas with low prevalence of stunting
    \item Elderly people with low incomes
    \item Adolescents in high-stress environments
\end{enumerate}
\item The \duallayerbox{coronal suture}{sagittal suture} joins the
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item parietal, squamous temporal and greater wing of the sphenoid.
    \item left and right parietal bones.
    \item parietal and sphenoid bones.
    \item frontal and occipital bones.
    \item squamous temporal and greater wing of the sphenoid.
\end{enumerate}
\item Which of the following appears to \duallayerbox{lower bad cholesterol}{have strong antioxidant effects}?
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
    \item Vitamin E
    \item Vitamin A
    \item Thiamine
    \item Niacin
    \item Vitamin B12
\end{enumerate}
\end{enumerate}

\item True or False: Enzyme assays \duallayerbox{are primarily used to diagnose carriers of Huntington's disease based on genetic mutations}{are not primarily used to diagnose carriers of Huntington's disease based on genetic mutations}.
\item True or False: People with \duallayerbox{no previous history of mental health issues}{a previous history of mental health issues} are more likely to experience depression after a loss.

\end{enumerate}
